prerequisites.en: Zeal to learn the subject (official prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI02000121)
prerequisites.gu: Zeal to learn the subject (official prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI02000121)

topics: 1.1 Concept and need of mechanical drafting. Drawing standards (IS-696 / SP 46)
1.2 Drawing of basic solids like prism, pyramid, cylinder and cone
1.3 Sectional view of basic solids and their applications
1.4 Surface development of solids and their uses in engineering field (only basic solids and their combinations)
2.1 Concept of orthographic reading
2.2 Need of sections, section lines and cutting plane
2.3 Types and applications of sections: full, half, revolved, removed, partial, off-set, aligned, etc.
2.4 Sectional view drawings from given isometric drawing / physical object and cutting plane conditions

title.en: Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) - Limits and Fits
title.gu: Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) - Limits and Fits

topics: 3.1 Importance of limits and fits, hole basis system and shaft basis system, types of fits, tolerance grade and fundamental deviation
3.2 Numerical based on limits and fits (compulsory numerical in exam)
4.1 Machining symbol, geometric symbol, weld joint symbols as per BIS-813, supplementary symbols, fluid and pipe fitting symbols, sketches of threads, studs, screws, nut, bolts, rivets, keys, etc.
4.2 Production drawing including GD&T and drafting symbols of simple mechanical assembly having minimum 5-6 components each made up of various manufacturing operations
5.1 Concept of assembly drawing having 4-5 mechanical parts, drawing of orthographic projections for each component
5.2 Fundamentals of detail drawing, Bill of Material (BOM) and assembly drawing
5.3 Demonstrate and explain 1-2 industrial example assembly drawings
6.1 Available software in CAD field and their capabilities
6.2 AutoCAD software window: Title bar, Ribbon tool bar, Quick Access Toolbar, Viewport, Command prompt, Draw tool bar, Modify, UCS, status bar, etc.
6.3 File features: opening new file, saving file, open drawing
6.4 Setting up new drawing: Unit, Limit, Grid, Snap, Dynmode, Orthomode, Polar, Snap, Osnap, Isodraft, Dynamic UCS, etc.
6.5 Co-ordinate system in AutoCAD: Absolute and Relative coordinates, Cartesian and Polar coordinates
6.6 Concept of Layers, Blocks and Hatch with applications
7.1 Dimensioning in AutoCAD
7.2 Dimension types: Linear, aligned, angular, radius, diameter, etc.
7.3 Dimension editing: adding text, rotating the dimension text
7.4 Text writing in AutoCAD: Single line, multi-line text

source_note: Official GTU syllabus DI02000121 (w.e.f. 2024-25), 4 pages, uploaded by the owner; text copy in tools/syllabus_DI02000121.txt. English-only notes as instructed by the owner for this subject.
source_discrepancies: Unit 3 is titled 'Geometric & Dimensioning Tolerances (GD&T)' in the official PDF but its printed contents cover limits and fits; geometric tolerancing symbols are covered under Unit 4 item 1 (geometric symbol) as printed.
Practicals 1 to 6 are to be drawn in sketch book and then on A2 size drawing sheet; Practical 7 is prepared in AutoCAD and plotted (official note).
